subject: Quick ask: short TrustRadius review from Quantify AI pilot?
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>

Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask: short TrustRadius review from Quantify AI pilot?

Hi Janet —

Hope you're doing well. Great to see the pilot metrics come through last week; Connor and I are thrilled with how the latency improvements landed for your batch scoring pipeline.

Quick favor to ask: would Quantify be open to a short public review on TrustRadius describing your pilot experience? Even a 5–7 sentence note about reliability and cost savings would be super helpful for other buyers evaluating inference platforms.

We typically offer a small thank-you for these (Amazon e-gift card, $75) and can also do a brief quote/QA call if you'd rather us draft something for you to approve. Attached is a one-page with instructions for posting and examples.

Two quick options — pick whichever works for you:
- Post directly on TrustRadius and I send the gift card once it's live (fastest)
- Do a 15-min call with Connor to capture a short case snippet we can write up and send to you for sign-off

If you're open, could you say which option you prefer and (if posting) whether it's okay to use your company name and title in the quote?

Thanks so much for considering — we really appreciate the partnership on this pilot.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0134

Attachments: TrustRadius-submission-steps.pdf (pdf), Quantify-pilot-summary-20260225.pdf (pdf)
From: Janet O'Neil <janet.oneil@quantify.ai>

Subject: Re: Quick ask: short TrustRadius review from Quantify AI pilot?

Hi Stephanie —

Thanks for the note and congrats on helping us get this moving. We're pleased with the pilot results. A couple of questions before we commit publicly:

1) Compliance: Can you confirm Redwood won't publicize any customer PII or internal dataset details in the case blurb? We only want high-level references to latency/cost gains.
2) Approval flow: If Connor drafts something, what is the expected turnaround for our review? We need to route it internally to legal and the CPO.

If those are fine, we can either post directly (I can do it) or have a short call. I think a 15-min call with Connor next week would be helpful to ensure the wording is accurate.

Thanks — I can do Tue 3/10 at 10:00 AM ET or Wed 3/11 at 2:00 PM ET.

Best,
Janet O'Neil
Head of ML Platform | Quantify AI
janet.oneil@quantify.ai
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>

Hi Janet —

Totally understand the compliance ask. Short answers:
- We never include customer PII or internal dataset identifiers in marketing snippets unless explicitly approved in writing (that's standard). We will keep the quote at a high level (latency, reliability, cost savings).
- If I draft the quote, we aim for a 24–48 hour internal turnaround for review once you receive it; legal/CPO sign-off will of course dictate the final timing.

If that sounds ok, let's lock Tue 3/10 at 10:00 AM ET for a brief call — I've put a tentative invite on calendar (will share details once Janet confirms).

Also looping Marcus since he oversees reference approvals and the small incentive program. Marcus — can you confirm the gift card amount is fine to offer for this case?

Cheers,

Thanks for looping me in. Approved — the $75 Amazon e-gift card is within our standard reference/incentive policy for pilot customers.

Janet — thanks again for being open to this. We'll proceed with the plan: Connor will run a 15-min capture call on Tue 3/10 10:00 AM ET, draft a short quote, and send it to you and your legal/CPO for approval. Once the review posts (or you confirm a posted screenshot), we'll send the $75 e-gift card to the email you prefer.

For convenience, here's the short checklist we'll follow:
- Capture 15-min call (Connor)
- Draft quote + 1-sentence summary (Connor)
- Quantify review + legal approval (Janet)
- Post on TrustRadius (Janet or Stephanie)
- Send e-gift card (Stephanie)

If anything changes, flag it and we'll adjust.
